executiveSummary.headline: Make the Golf and Family Proposition Easier to Choose
executiveSummary.lead: Sheraton Mallorca Arabella Golf Hotel has a clear absolute visibility gap: 20.6% consideration, 35.6% scenario presence, and third place among four Marriott Bonvoy peers. The peer rank should not be treated as a strong position.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: These metrics describe presence in monitored AI answers—not bookings, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: The Core Resort Offer Is Distinctive
themes.what: Official content presents 93 rooms, access to four courses and 63 holes, a Kids Club, Shine Spa, and strong golf, family, and wellness positioning.
themes.whyItMatters: These are useful decision facts, but their relationships, availability, operating conditions, and audience fit must remain precise and consistent across official sources.

themes.title: Golf and Meetings Need a Planner Test
themes.what: Meetings and golf content already exists; the open question is whether the combination is sufficiently clear for planners considering a golf retreat or small group.
themes.whyItMatters: A targeted planner-journey review is more useful than inventing a missing page or publishing an unapproved package with unclear operational ownership.

themes.title: Sister-Hotel Displacement Needs Careful Positioning
themes.what: Castillo Hotel Son Vida displaced Sheraton in ADP within the same Arabella/Son Vida cluster, while Marriott access probes also returned an Akamai 403 pattern.
themes.whyItMatters: The hotel needs factual audience differentiation and a bounded platform review, not criticism of its sister property or assumptions about why displacement occurred.

priorities.action: Lock golf, family, wellness, and room facts

executiveSummary.successLooksLike: Core resort facts are approved and consistent, planners can understand the golf-and-meetings fit where commercially desired, and sister-hotel and access questions have documented outcomes.
executiveSummary.closing: Executive Takeaway: Sheraton Mallorca Arabella Golf Hotel needs stronger absolute consideration, but the first move is disciplined clarity. Make the 93-room golf, family, and wellness offer unmistakable, define its role beside Castillo Son Vida, and add retreat packaging only if sales confirms the opportunity.

methodology.scope: Combines the certified ADP baseline with a bounded review of named public pages and zero-cost technical probes. No paid research, Airtable write, ADP remeasurement, or customer publication was performed.
claimTypeGuide: VERIFIED_ISSUE — a directly observed, source-backed discrepancy.
RECOMMENDED_INVESTIGATION — evidence warrants review but does not prove a defect or cause.
REQUIRES_HOTEL_CONFIRMATION — hotel leadership must establish the source of truth before correction.
OPTIONAL_COMMERCIAL_OPPORTUNITY — proceed only if leadership wants the demand.
responsibilities: Hotel leadership confirms facts, priorities, and public changes.
Digital or brand teams implement only approved corrections and document verification.
Dealality packages measurement context and evidence without implying booking or revenue causation.
methodology.monthlyReviewRelationship: Approved actions may be tracked in a later review. Completing an action does not itself prove a change in AI presence, bookings, or revenue.
